nodes.label: Mandatory phase-close ritual
nodes.rationale: Makes the management update a numbered step, not a "should", so nothing goes stale.

nodes.label: Branch hygiene
nodes.rationale: Absorption verified (merged/cherry/merge-tree); absorbed deleted with -d; unabsorbed reported, never deleted.

nodes.rationale: Captured in docs/spec/backlog.md; becomes new change-id at archive sweep.

nodes.rationale: Revision sub-cycle: approvals.requirements false, iteration_count+1, revision_history entry.

nodes.label: 5 Logical States (todo/in_progress/review/done/blocked)

nodes.label: notifications.channel (google-chat/slack/teams/email/webhook/none)

nodes.label: Support Layer (18 skills)
nodes.rationale: Support skills do not advance spec.json:phase; only karvey-iterate may do the controlled backward transition.

nodes.rationale: Plugin has no install hook, so settings are asked on first use: session hook warns, karvey-init asks.

nodes.label: Settings-only mode (--settings)

nodes.label: Step 3.2 Team settings on first use

nodes.label: Principle: Approval gates
nodes.rationale: --autoplan batches planning gates, never skips them.

nodes.label: Principle: Human OK for production
nodes.rationale: Production merge never delegated to an agent; recorded in approvals.prod.

nodes.label: Principle: Measured, not remembered
nodes.rationale: Only session-verified facts reported; handoff captured by commands.

nodes.label: Principle: Spiral, not line
nodes.rationale: Pipeline is the happy path; findings return via bug/spec-gap/emergent edges; ready only on convergence.

nodes.label: Version bump and visible version per environment
nodes.norm_label: version bump and visible version per environment
nodes.rationale: Version read from version file at build time, never a pipeline variable that goes stale.

nodes.label: --autoplan planning chain (phases 0-5)

nodes.label: PRD as base + traceable EARS requirements
nodes.norm_label: prd as base + traceable ears requirements

nodes.label: Stack-agnostic (targets)
nodes.rationale: The project declares its targets and each phase adapts (web, mobile, desktop, CLI, API, embedded).

nodes.label: Deploy Platform One-time Configuration
nodes.rationale: Configured once so karvey-deploy need not rediscover; inspired by gstack setup-deploy.

nodes.norm_label: dm-07: test-first and verifiable req->task->commit->test traceability matrix

nodes.norm_label: r-11: expert judge panels at early gates (ju-01, karvey-judges)

nodes.label: R-12: Test-first and REQ->task->commit->test traceability matrix
nodes.norm_label: r-12: test-first and req->task->commit->test traceability matrix
nodes.rationale: A requirement without a test becomes visible before merge.

nodes.label: [human] Tasks and awaiting-human State
nodes.rationale: Agent never executes human tasks; runs only read-only verification after human reports done.

nodes.label: Idempotent Infra Discovery
nodes.rationale: Never recreate existing infra; only create missing or modify needed.

nodes.label: Ops Command Plan + Versioned IAM Scripts
nodes.norm_label: ops command plan + versioned iam scripts
nodes.rationale: Verification asserts the binding itself, not only its effect, to detect over-granting.

nodes.label: 10-30 min Task Granularity Rules
nodes.rationale: 1 task = 1 AI-executable unit with observable done criterion; max 1h.

nodes.label: Automatic Regression Tests + BUG-NN Logging
nodes.rationale: Incident reaches RESUELTO only with a regression test.

nodes.norm_label: archiving protocol (merge deltas, move to archive)

nodes.norm_label: approvals with decision reference (prod never delegated)

nodes.norm_label: hotfix lane (fix + bug-nn + regression test in same pr)

nodes.label: Deviation Request (design mode escalation)
nodes.rationale: The agent never resolves a departure from the standard silently.

nodes.label: Afan (Karvey spiral principle)
nodes.rationale: You don't stop until the result is really achieved; nothing is dropped.

nodes.label: Writers vs router separation
nodes.rationale: Separating observation from routing keeps loop logic in one place (karvey-iterate).
